description: This file provides utilities for aligning, correcting, and normalizing subtitle entries using a Whisper model transcript as reference. It includes functions for matching subtitle segments to transcript segments, ensuring monotonic timing, merging blank subtitles, and adjusting timestamps and text to improve subtitle accuracy and consistency.

methods.name: bool _is_blank(text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if a given text string is None or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: str _normalize_space(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes spacing in a string by collapsing multiple spaces into one and stripping leading/trailing whitespace.

methods.name: float _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates the duration of overlap between two time intervals.

methods.name: float _interval_center(iv: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates the center point of a time interval.

methods.name: float _safe_time(t: float)
methods.description: Ensures that a timestamp is not negative, clamping it to zero if necessary.

methods.name: Any _get_seg_value(seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)
methods.description: Safely retrieves a value from a segment, whether it is dict-like or object-like, returning a default if unavailable.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_seg_dict(seg: Any)
methods.description: Converts an arbitrary transcript segment into a standardized dict with 'start', 'end', and 'text' keys.

methods.name: None _ensure_monotonic(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle timings in-place to ensure they are monotonic, non-overlapping, and respect minimal gaps.

methods.name: Optional[int] _match_transcript_segment( sub_iv: Tuple[float, float], transcript: List[Dict], )
methods.description: Finds the index of the transcript segment that best matches a given subtitle interval using overlap and proximity criteria.

methods.name: Optional[int] _closest_transcript_index_by_time(point: float, transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Finds the index of the transcript segment whose center is closest to a given point in time.

methods.name: List[Dict] _merge_adjacent_blanks(subs: List[Dict])
methods.description: Merges consecutive blank-text subtitles to reduce fragmentation.

methods.name: None _apply_text_from_transcript(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Updates a subtitle's text from the transcript segment if missing or for normalization, with debug printing.

methods.name: None _refit_times_to_segment(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle start/end times to better fit the corresponding transcript segment, if needed, with debug output.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles( transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict], *, cross_lingual: bool = False, preserve_subtitle_text: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Main function that aligns and corrects a list of subtitles based on a transcript, adjusting timings and optionally subtitle texts, ensuring monotonicity and applying various heuristics for timing and content consistency.

ctags.name: _get_seg_value
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_seg_value(seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:$/
ctags.signature: (seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)

ctags.name: _overlap
ctags.pattern: /^def _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:$/

ctags.name: align_subtitles
ctags.signature: ( transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict], *, cross_lingual: bool = False, preserve_subtitle_text: Optional[bool] = None, )
